messages:
maria: Quick synthesis from the last 2 PMs 8 remediations are drifting. Proposal: lightweight follow-up process = owner ack within 48h, weekly 2-3 bullet pulse, auto-reminders at 7d/30d, escalation at 45d. Thoughts?
sam: Strong +1. Also require IC to be context owner for first 7 days, then handoff or remain owner. IC ack reduces churn.
leo: +1. Add 'blocked-by' and risk (L/M/H) to tracker. Also tag remediations with a short fingerprint for recurrence analysis.
dina: For comms: weekly digest to #incidents, biweekly deep-dive in ops retro, monthly trends review. Who can draft the first digest?
irene: I can create a GitHub project board with issue templates, labels (risk,fingerprint,blocked-by) and a webhook to Slack. Will have a sample by Friday.
maria: Draft timeline: Day0 incident+IC; Day1 postmortem draft+assign owners (owners ACK within 48h); Day7 pulse update; Day14 pulse; Day30 review; Day45 escalate if unresolved. Add 15m handoff meeting within 5 days if work continues beyond 7d.
sam: Will add owner-ack + 15m handoff to the postmortem template by Tue.
leo: I'll draft the weekly digest format and post a sample next Wed.
dina: I'll schedule the biweekly retro deep-dive and monthly trend slot.
irene: ACK. Will post board link and setup steps when ready.
ops-bot: [automation] Created project board: https://github.com/redwood-inference/incident-remediations (private).
maria: Thanks all. Quick sync next Thu 10:00 in #eng-oncall to review board + sample digest and finalize process.
